The '''Fortress of Tawntoom''' was the headquarters of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]], located in the [[Tawntoom]] colony on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. It was built into the walls of a volcanic crater and powered by the thermal energy generated by the lava pit far below the fortress. It was destroyed after the the base's core overloded and exploded.
